_comment: SPARK — S167: design seeds for the OWNER-RULED BOSS SKILL VFX (R138/R139/R140).
⭐ THE OWNER ASKED FOR THESE BY NAME, mid-session: *"also their skills need a generated video or
art (explosion for zombie boss and stinky deadly aura around him)"* and *"we would need to
generate cool graphics for those abilities"*. Only the THREE skill sets he has RULED are here —
Pharaoh, Warlord and Archdemon remain his (*"the rest iil think about"*), so nothing is generated
for them.
⭐ THE ISOLATION CLAUSE, AND IT IS THE WHOLE REASON THESE PROMPTS ARE WRITTEN THIS WAY.
`build-sprite-atlas.mjs` mattes by finding near-white CONNECTED TO THE FRAME BORDER, so anything
that is not the effect — a floor, a horizon, a creature, a shadow — is welded into the cut-out and
then drawn over the game board forever. Every prompt below therefore demands the effect ALONE on
pure white, with no ground and no character.
⛔ AND NO SEED IMAGE, WHICH IS WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AT ALL. `gen-character-clips.mjs` is
IMAGE-to-video only — it resolves `ch.seed` unconditionally and throws without one. That is
correct for characters (the seed is what keeps idle/walk/attack the same goblin) and it means an
effect needs a design PNG first, exactly like every character in this project. Design -> clip ->
atlas, the same three stages.
⚠ THE SKILLS ARE NOT WIRED YET, DELIBERATELY. `RACE_ZONES_AND_BOSS_TOWERS.md` §S167 costs the
mechanics and finds a real blocker: there is no single place that knows a creature died, so a
death-explosion hook would fire for creature kills and miss tower kills. The ART is generated now
because he asked for it and it is the long-lead item; the CODE waits on that design and on his
skill stats.
